title: Apple Watch Users Should Update Now: What’s Inside watchOS 27.2
content:
Apple’s watchOS 27.2 brings a series of updates designed to enhance the functionality and overall user experience of the Apple Watch. With improvements ranging from a redesigned music app to smarter Siri capabilities, this update refines existing features while laying the groundwork for future advancements. However, some anticipated features, such as the revamped health app, were not included in the final release. Below is a detailed look at the most significant changes and their practical implications for users. The video below from Half Man Half Tech gives us more details on the new watchOS update.

The music app in watchOS 27.2 has been overhauled with a minimalist design that prioritizes ease of use. Featuring a clean white background and a bold black music note icon, the app now aligns visually with Apple’s broader ecosystem, making sure a cohesive experience across devices. The navigation has been streamlined, allowing users to access playlists, albums, and individual songs with fewer taps. While the app retains its core functionality, the updated interface enhances usability and makes managing your music library more intuitive. This redesign underscores Apple’s commitment to blending aesthetic appeal with practical functionality.

The app switcher makes a comeback in watchOS 27.2, albeit in a more limited form. This feature allows users to toggle between certain open applications or close them using either the digital crown or touch gestures. While the multitasking capabilities are not as robust as in earlier iterations, the app switcher improves navigation for users who frequently switch between tasks. Though its functionality is restricted, it remains a useful addition for enhancing productivity on the Apple Watch.

Siri receives significant upgrades in watchOS 27.2, making it both faster and more versatile. The virtual assistant can now recall previous interactions and integrate data from apps such as Messages, Notes, and voicemails. Additionally, Siri’s language support has been expanded to include French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish, making it more accessible to a global audience. These enhancements not only improve Siri’s responsiveness but also reflect Apple’s focus on personalization and inclusivity. Whether you’re setting reminders, sending messages, or retrieving information, Siri’s improved capabilities make it a more reliable assistant for everyday tasks.

One of the most anticipated updates, the redesigned health app, was previewed during beta testing but is absent from the final release of watchOS 27.2. This app was expected to introduce features such as longevity tracking and advanced health data insights. While its omission is disappointing, Apple has hinted that these features may be included in a future update, possibly in watchOS 27.3. For now, users will need to rely on the existing health tracking tools, which still provide valuable insights into fitness and wellness metrics.

To install watchOS 27.2, you’ll need an iPhone running iOS 27.2. The update is compatible with a range of Apple Watch models, including the latest iPhone Duo. However, some of Siri’s advanced features, such as expanded language support and deeper app integration, are being rolled out in beta and are only available in select regions. This phased rollout ensures a smoother implementation but may limit access for users in certain locations. If you’re in a supported region, you’ll benefit from enhanced functionality and improved performance.

Siri’s integration with apps like photos, calendar and Safari has been expanded, offering users more control and customization options. For instance, you can now ask Siri to locate a specific photo, summarize your daily schedule, or even provide tailored recommendations based on your preferences. Customizable settings allow you to determine which apps and data Siri can access, giving you greater control over your privacy. These updates make Siri a more powerful and adaptable tool for managing your digital life.

The watchOS 27.2 update focuses on refining existing features rather than introducing entirely new ones. The redesigned music app and Siri enhancements stand out as the most impactful changes, offering users a more polished and intuitive experience. While the limited app switcher and the absence of the health app leave room for improvement, the update delivers meaningful upgrades that enhance the overall functionality of the Apple Watch. If you’re seeking a more streamlined and user-friendly interface, watchOS 27.2 represents a step forward in usability and performance.

title: New Google Accessibility Features Added to Pixel and Android
content:
Google has introduced new accessibility updates aimed at meeting diverse user needs across its platforms. One standout feature is Rambler, a speech-to-text function available on Pixel 11 devices that allows users to make voice-based corrections, providing a practical way to improve communication accuracy. Additional updates, such as Guided Frame and Guided Vision, offer audio assistance for low-vision users, supporting tasks like taking photos and identifying objects. These updates highlight Google’s efforts to address specific challenges faced by individuals with disabilities.

Explore how features like Motion Assist help reduce discomfort during device use in moving vehicles, while Voice Access improvements expand hands-free navigation with enhanced feedback. Learn about Chrome Reading Mode, which minimizes visual distractions for better readability and Gboard emoji scaling, designed to improve visibility for users with low vision. These updates provide concrete examples of how accessibility is being incorporated into everyday technology.

Google introduced a variety of accessibility updates across Pixel, Android, Chrome, Gboard, Gemini AI, Workspace and Search, focusing on inclusivity and usability for individuals with disabilities. New tools like Rambler (speech-to-text) and Sign-to-Text Translation (real-time ASL to text) enhance communication for users relying on voice input or sign language. Features like Guided Frame, Guided Vision and Motion Assist empower low-vision users and reduce motion sickness, improving independence and comfort. Enhancements to Voice Access, Gboard emoji scaling and Chrome Reading Mode provide better hands-free navigation, visibility and distraction-free reading experiences. The Accessibility Help Community and Gemini AI-powered Workspace tools support neurodivergent users, promote collaboration and address diverse cognitive and accessibility needs.

Below is an in-depth look at these updates and their potential to shape a more accessible digital experience.

Rambler is a new speech-to-text tool that simplifies the process of converting spoken language into written text. Designed to recognize natural speech patterns, it allows users to make self-corrections and edits using voice commands. Currently available on Pixel 11 devices, Rambler is expected to roll out to additional devices in the near future. Whether you’re dictating notes, composing emails, or sending messages, this tool ensures accuracy and ease of use, making it particularly valuable for individuals who rely on voice input for communication.

Google’s Sign-to-Text Translation feature provides real-time conversion of American Sign Language (ASL) into written English. Supporting both one-handed and two-handed signing, this tool integrates seamlessly with Gboard, allowing users to perform tasks such as web searches, messaging and more. Initially launched on Pixel 11, Google plans to expand this feature to additional devices and other sign languages, broadening its accessibility to a wider audience.

Find more information on Google by browsing our extensive range of articles, guides and tutorials.

Both features are currently available on Pixel 11 devices, with plans for broader availability in the future. These tools are designed to empower users with low vision by offering greater independence in daily activities.

Motion Assist is a feature designed to address motion sickness experienced by users when operating Android devices in moving vehicles. By introducing a bubble overlay that stabilizes on-screen visuals, this tool ensures a more comfortable viewing experience. Available on Android 17 and later, Motion Assist is particularly beneficial for individuals who are prone to motion sensitivity, allowing them to use their devices without discomfort.

Google has enhanced its Voice Access tool to make hands-free navigation more intuitive and user-friendly. Key updates include:

These updates aim to provide a smoother and more accessible experience for users who rely on voice commands to navigate their devices.

Gboard now includes customizable emoji scaling, allowing emoji sizes to adjust based on the system font size. This update ensures a consistent and accessible visual experience, particularly for users with low vision or those who prefer larger text. By enhancing visibility, this feature makes communication through emojis more inclusive and enjoyable.

The new Reading Mode in Chrome is designed to improve readability by removing unnecessary elements from cluttered webpages. By focusing solely on the text, this feature creates a distraction-free environment, making it easier for users to concentrate on the content. This tool is especially beneficial for individuals who require an immersive and simplified reading experience.

Google Workspace, powered by Gemini AI, introduces tools tailored to support neurodivergent users. These features are designed to assist with:

Developed in collaboration with Understood.org, these tools aim to enhance executive functioning and task management, addressing the diverse cognitive needs of users.

Google Search now offers improved keyboard navigation for desktop users, making interactions more efficient and accessible. New shortcuts simplify navigation in AI Mode, while jump links provide quick access to earlier conversation points. These updates are particularly useful for individuals who rely on keyboard inputs, making sure a smoother and more intuitive search experience.

By creating this community, Google aims to empower users, encourage knowledge sharing and drive advancements in accessibility technology.

Google’s latest accessibility updates reflect its dedication to creating a more inclusive digital ecosystem. From tools like Rambler and Sign-to-Text Translation to features such as Guided Vision and Workspace AI, these innovations cater to a wide range of user needs. As technology continues to evolve, Google’s initiatives highlight the importance of empowering individuals and fostering inclusivity, making sure that everyone can benefit from advancements in the digital age.

title: Samsung’s Galaxy Z Fold 9 May Take an Unexpected Turn
content:
The Galaxy Z Fold 9 is set to establish a new standard in the foldable smartphone market. With its focus on a refined design, innovative hardware, and innovative features, Samsung aims to solidify its leadership amidst increasing competition, including Apple’s anticipated entry into the foldable space. This next-generation device offers a glimpse into the future of mobile technology, combining practicality with advanced functionality. The video below from TT Technology gives us more details on what Samsung has planned for their new Galaxy Z Fold 9.

Samsung has prioritized addressing one of the most common concerns with foldable devices, bulkiness. The Galaxy Z Fold 9 is expected to feature a significantly thinner profile, measuring just 3.9 mm when unfolded and 7.9 mm when folded. This streamlined design enhances portability and ensures a more comfortable user experience.

Additionally, the rear camera module may undergo a redesign to reduce its protrusion, resulting in a more seamless and ergonomic device. These improvements reflect Samsung’s commitment to creating a foldable smartphone that balances aesthetics with practicality, making it more appealing for everyday use.

At the core of the Galaxy Z Fold 9 lies Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chipset, a processor designed to deliver exceptional performance and energy efficiency. This hardware upgrade ensures smoother multitasking, faster app launches and extended battery life, catering to users who demand high performance from their devices.

Samsung is also rumored to increase the battery capacity while introducing 60W fast charging, a feature that significantly reduces charging times. This enhancement is particularly beneficial for users with busy schedules, making sure the device remains powered throughout the day with minimal downtime.

Samsung continues to push the boundaries of display technology with the introduction of center-etched thin glass (CTG). This innovation minimizes the visibility of the crease on the foldable screen, providing a more immersive and visually appealing experience. Whether you’re streaming videos, gaming, or multitasking, the improved display ensures a seamless viewing experience.

The under-display selfie camera is also expected to make a return, offering an uninterrupted internal display. This feature enhances the device’s versatility, making it ideal for activities that require a full-screen experience, such as video calls, content creation and productivity tasks.

The Galaxy Z Fold 9 is rumored to feature a 200 MP primary camera, a significant leap in mobile photography. This high-resolution sensor is designed to capture stunning detail and vibrant colors, rivaling the capabilities of Samsung’s Galaxy S Ultra series.

Complementing the primary camera is a 50 MP telephoto lens with 5x optical zoom, allowing users to take clear and detailed shots even from a distance. These upgrades highlight Samsung’s dedication to delivering flagship-level photography in its foldable lineup, making the Galaxy Z Fold 9 a versatile tool for both casual and professional photographers.

Durability remains a key focus for Samsung, with the Galaxy Z Fold 9 reportedly targeting an IP68 water resistance rating. This improvement ensures the device can withstand everyday splashes and even accidental submersion, offering peace of mind for users in various environments.

The anticipated return of S Pen support further enhances the device’s functionality, particularly for productivity-focused users. Whether you’re taking notes, sketching, or editing documents, the S Pen transforms the Galaxy Z Fold 9 into a powerful tool for creative and professional tasks.

Samsung’s ambitions for foldable technology extend beyond the Galaxy Z Fold 9. By 2027, the company plans to introduce up to six foldable models, including the Z Flip 9, Z Fold 9 Pro, Z Fold 9 Ultra, Z Tri-Fold 2 and Z Slide.

The Z Slide, in particular, is expected to feature a rollable, sliding display, showcasing Samsung’s dedication to exploring new form factors and pushing the boundaries of mobile innovation. These developments underline the company’s vision for a diverse and versatile foldable lineup that caters to a wide range of user preferences.

The Galaxy Z Fold 9 is anticipated to debut in July 2027, with availability beginning in August. Pricing is expected to align with the Z Fold 8 series, ranging from $1,899 to $2,099, positioning the device as a premium option for early adopters and tech enthusiasts. This pricing reflects the advanced features and innovative technology packed into the device, appealing to those seeking the forefront of mobile innovation.

The Galaxy Z Fold 9 represents a significant advancement in foldable smartphone technology. By addressing key user concerns such as bulkiness and durability while introducing features like a 200 MP camera, faster charging, and a more immersive display, Samsung is setting a high standard for the industry.

Whether you’re drawn to its sleek design, powerful performance, or innovative display technology, the Galaxy Z Fold 9 offers a compelling experience for users seeking the latest in mobile innovation. This device not only redefines what a foldable smartphone can achieve but also reinforces Samsung’s position as a leader in the evolving world of mobile technology.

title: CISA Confirms Active Exploits Targeting Plex Media Server
content:
Critical vulnerabilities in widely used platforms demand immediate attention, with some already under active exploitation. Among these, the Plex Media Server stands out as a high-priority concern due to confirmed unauthenticated remote code execution attacks targeting older, internet-exposed versions. Ton explores the importance of updating to version 1.43.3.10861 or later and emphasizes steps like investigating potential compromises and rebuilding systems to eliminate backdoors. This guide highlights the urgency of addressing such flaws to protect your infrastructure from escalating threats.

Dive into actionable strategies to secure your systems against these risks. You’ll gain insight into prioritizing patches for actively exploited vulnerabilities, such as those in Plex and Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator, while also preparing for potential threats from critical flaws in PHP and GitLab. Additionally, discover how to strengthen your defenses by updating essential components like Node.js, Pillow and Ubuntu packages. By following these steps, you can bolster your security posture and mitigate exposure to emerging attack vectors.

Critical vulnerabilities have been identified in widely used platforms like Plex Media Server, Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator and Nextcloud Collabora CODE Server, with some already under active exploitation. Plex Media Server is a key target for attackers, with unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerabilities; immediate updates and system checks are recommended. Severe flaws in PHP and GitLab, though not yet actively exploited, pose significant risks and require urgent patching to prevent potential attacks. Updates for Node.js, Pillow and Ubuntu address critical security issues, including heap-overflow vulnerabilities and protocol weaknesses, necessitating prompt action. Prioritize patching based on exposure and exploitation likelihood, focusing first on actively exploited vulnerabilities, followed by critical flaws in other platforms.

The Plex Media Server has become a prominent target for attackers, with the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) confirming active exploitation. Older versions of the server, particularly those exposed to the internet, are vulnerable to unauthenticated remote code execution through a chained attack.

A critical SQL injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-114625) has been identified in Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem, which is currently under active exploitation. Attackers can use this flaw by using a valid portal session and a low-privilege account to gain unauthorized access.

Here are more guides from our previous articles and guides related to Plex that you may find helpful.

The Nextcloud Collabora CODE Server is being actively targeted due to a vulnerability (CVE-2026-110447) that allows OS command execution under specific conditions. This flaw affects the richdocumentscode app, which is commonly used for collaborative document editing.

Two critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) have been discovered in PHP, affecting configurations such as Apache mod_php and PHP FPM. While no active exploitation has been reported, the severity of these flaws warrants immediate action.

GitLab has disclosed a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-110264) with a maximum CVSS score of 10, indicating the highest level of severity. This flaw enables unauthenticated remote code execution and affects both the Community and Enterprise Editions of self-managed GitLab instances.

Recent updates to Node.js address vulnerabilities in Brotli compression, DNS handling, and TLS protocols. These flaws could expose applications to potential attacks if left unpatched.

A critical JPEG heap-overflow vulnerability has been identified in version 13.0.0 of the Pillow library. This flaw could allow attackers to execute arbitrary code if your applications process untrusted image files.

Ubuntu has released updates to address vulnerabilities in key components such as U-Boot, OpenVPN, and zlib. These updates are critical for maintaining the security and stability of systems that rely on these components.

To effectively mitigate risks and secure your systems, follow this prioritization strategy:

By addressing these vulnerabilities promptly, you can significantly reduce the risk of compromise and ensure the continued security of your systems. Staying proactive in applying updates and monitoring for unusual activity is essential to maintaining a robust security posture.

title: Ekspor Diesel India Naik, Siap Redakan Krisis Global Tahun Depan
summary: Lonjakan ekspor diesel dari India diperkirakan akan membanjiri pasar global tahun depan, seiring beroperasinya kapasitas penyulingan baru.
content:
PASOKAN ENERGI Ekspor Diesel India Naik, Siap Redakan Krisis Global Tahun Depan

Kilang minyak yang dioperasikan oleh Bharat Petroleum Corp. Ltd., di Mumbai, India./Bloomberg-Dhiraj Singh

Bloomberg, Lonjakan ekspor diesel dari India diperkirakan akan membanjiri pasar global tahun depan, seiring beroperasinya kapasitas penyulingan baru. Hal ini akan menyediakan pasokan yang sangat dibutuhkan bagi pasar yang mengalami kekurangan bahan bakar, mulai dari Amerika Serikat hingga Eropa.

Menteri Perminyakan India, Hardeep Singh Puri mengatakan perusahaan penyulingan milik negara akan menambah kapasitas produksi diesel tahunan setidaknya sebesar 15 juta ton, melalui pembangunan kilang baru dan perluasan fasilitas yang sudah ada.

"Kita akan berada dalam situasi yang menguntungkan, di mana kita tidak hanya melakukan penyulingan untuk kebutuhan dalam negeri, tetapi juga untuk dunia," ujar Puri kepada wartawan di sela-sela konferensi industri di Goa pada Selasa (27/10/2026).

Konflik di Timur Tengah dan perang Rusia-Ukraina telah mengganggu aliran minyak mentah dan bahan bakar, sehingga memperketat pasokan global dan memicu kenaikan harga tahun ini.

title: BCA Ungkap Permintaan Kredit Dunia Usaha Naik, Ini Pendorongnya
summary: BCA Ungkap Permintaan Kredit Dunia Usaha Mulai Naik, Ini Pendorongnya
content:
BCA Ungkap Permintaan Kredit Dunia Usaha Naik, Ini Pendorongnya

Bloomberg Technoz, Jakarta - PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) mengungkapkan permintaan kredit dari dunia usaha mulai meningkat hingga kuartal III-2026. Kenaikan tersebut antara lain didorong kebutuhan modal kerja untuk mengantisipasi peningkatan aktivitas bisnis menjelang akhir tahun serta periode musiman.

Wakil Presiden Direktur BCA John Kosasih mengatakan permintaan kredit mulai meningkat seiring kebutuhan dunia usaha mempersiapkan aktivitas bisnis menjelang Natal dan Tahun Baru serta Lebaran.

“Kalau kita perhatikan, ini memang didorong business season,” ujar John dalam paparan kinerja BCA kuartal III-2026, Selasa (27/10/2026).

John menjelaskan, dunia usaha umumnya mulai melakukan pengadaan dan persiapan produksi sekitar empat hingga lima bulan sebelum periode musiman tersebut. Langkah itu dilakukan untuk mengantisipasi peningkatan kebutuhan barang dan aktivitas bisnis.

Selain faktor musiman, John melihat adanya peningkatan kebutuhan modal kerja. Pembiayaan tersebut diperlukan untuk mengantisipasi kebutuhan operasional menjelang akhir tahun dan berbagai periode dengan permintaan yang lebih tinggi.

title: Keluhan Layar Merusak Sambutan Meriah iPhone Duo
summary: Desain iPhone lipat perdana Apple Inc belum sempurna karena ditemukan ada banyak retakan.
content:
Pelanggan mencoba iPhone Duo saat hari petama penjualan di toko Apple Jing'an, Shanghai, Tiongkok, Jumat (23/10/2026). (Qilai Shen/Bloomberg)

Bloomberg Technoz, Jakarta - Layar iPhone Duo, ponsel Apple Inc dengan desain yang sepenuhnya baru, tidak sempurna. Banyak pengguna yang baru beberapa jam menggunakan mengeluhkan retak, merusak antusiasme banyak fanboy produk asal Cupertino, California, Amerika Serikat tersebut selang beberapa pekan perilisan.

Retakan muncul pada bagian tengah di sekitar garis lipatan iPhone Duo, berdasarkan pengakuan banyak penggunanya. Laporan pengguna lain menyebut mengalami eror tampilan pada salah satu bidang layar atau muncul titik putih.

Salah satu pengguna, Jonathan King, menceritakan bahwa mendengar suara retak dan kemudian mendapati kondisi layar bagian dalam iPhone Duo sudah tidak berfungsi, sementara layar luar normal.

Pemilik iPhone Duo lain, Tom Battle, bercerita ponselnya lebih berat saat percobaan membuka. Dia juga mendapati adanya bidang menonjol pada sisi dalam layarnya.

Kerusakan berupa garis retakan dialami pengguna iPhone Duo lainnya, Centrino31A, yang bercerita kepada Bloomberg. “Bukan kerusakan di layar sisi luar, tapi di bagian dalammnya.”

title: BCA Proyeksi Kredit Tumbuh 10%-12% pada 2026, Lampaui Target
summary: Bank BCA memproyeksikan pertumbuhan kredit sepanjang 2026 mencapai 10%-12% secara tahunan (year-on-year/YoY).
content:
BCA Proyeksi Kredit Tumbuh 10%-12% pada 2026, Lampaui Target

Bloomberg Technoz, Jakarta - PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) memproyeksikan pertumbuhan kredit sepanjang 2026 mencapai 10%-12% secara tahunan (year-on-year/YoY), lebih tinggi dibandingkan target awal sebesar 8%-10%.

Proyeksi tersebut mempertimbangkan perkembangan permintaan pembiayaan hingga kuartal III-2026.

Dalam sesi paparan kinerja kuartal III-2026, Direktur BCA Vera Eve Lim menyatakan proyeksi pertumbuhan kredit tahun ini berpotensi melampaui target awal perseroan.

“Di rencana awal kami adalah 8%-10%. Namun, mempertimbangkan perkembangan memasuki kuartal ketiga, perkiraan kami terakhir adalah pertumbuhan untuk 2026 bisa mencapai double digit, yaitu di kisaran 10%-12%,” ujar Vera dalam paparan kinerja, Selasa (27/10/2026).

Meski proyeksi pertumbuhan kredit meningkat, manajemen menyatakan tidak akan merevisi target dalam Rencana Bisnis Bank (RBB).

title: BRIN Mau Sulap Sawit Jadi Listrik, Kapasitas Diproyeksi 3,9 GW
summary: BRIN berencana mengembangkan limbah sawit palm oil mill effluent (POME) menjadi energi listrik melalui pembangkit listrik tenaga biogas (PLTBg).
content:
BAHAN BAKAR NABATI BRIN Mau Sulap Sawit Jadi Listrik, Kapasitas Diproyeksi 3,9 GW

Pekerja menurunkan buah kelapa sawit hasil panen di pabrik produksi PT Perkebunan Nusantara di Kertajaya, Banten./Bloomberg-Dadang Tri

Bloomberg Technoz, Jakarta - Ketua Badan Riset dan Inovasi Nasional (BRIN) Arif Satria mengatakan pihaknya berencana mengembangkan limbah sawit palm oil mill effluent (POME) menjadi energi listrik melalui pembangkit listrik tenaga biogas (PLTBg).

Arif memperkirakan kapasitas listrik yang dihasilkan dari pemanfaatan POME—limbah cair hasil dari proses pengolahan tandan buah segar (TBS) menjadi crude palm oil (CPO)—mencapai sekitar 3,9 gigawatt.

"Tadi kami juga melaporkan kepada Bapak Presiden sejumlah potensi energi yang dapat dikembangkan, salah satunya melalui pemanfaatan limbah sawit menjadi biogas," ujar Arif kepada awak media di kompleks Istana Kepresidenan, Jakarta, Selasa (27/10/2026).

"Ini merupakan potensi yang cukup besar untuk menghasilkan energi alternatif dari limbah," imbuhnya.

Menurut Arif, produksi TBS sawit di Indonesia mencapai kurang lebih 328,43 juta ton per tahun, sementara POME mencapai sekitar 229,9 juta meter kubik per tahun.

title: Arus Mudik Nataru, Polri Fokus Ramp Check dan Jalur Wisata
summary: Polri akan menggelar Operasi Zebra dengan fokus pada pemeriksaan kelaikan bus, pengecekan infrastruktur jalan, hingga rekayasa lalu lintas.
content:
Suasana lalu lintas kendaraan di jalan ibu kota Jakarta. (Bloomberg Technoz/Andrean Kristianto)

Bloomberg Technoz, Jakarta - Korps Lalu Lintas (Korlantas) Polri menyiapkan mengakui potensi kepadatan lalu lintas selama libur Natal 2026 dan Tahun Baru 2027 (Nataru). Polri akan menggelar Operasi Zebra dengan fokus pada pemeriksaan kelaikan bus, pengecekan infrastruktur jalan, hingga rekayasa lalu lintas di jalur wisata.

Hal itu diungkapkan Kakorlantas Polri, Brigjen Aries Syahbudin usai Rapat Koordinasi Persiapan Penyelenggaraan Angkutan Libur Natal 2026 dan Tahun Baru 2027 di Gedung Karya Kementerian Perhubungan, Selasa (27/10/2026).

“Pada saat pelaksanaan Operasi Zebra, kita (Korlantas Polri) akan melaksanakan kegiatan ramp check kendaraan-kendaraan karena nanti kendaraan angkutan umum ini menjadi salah satu sarana transportasi yang diminati masyarakat,” ujarnya.

Pemeriksaan menjadi bagian dari upaya memastikan kendaraan yang digunakan masyarakat memenuhi persyaratan keselamatan sebelum menempuh perjalanan jarak jauh.

Tak hanya kendaraan, Polri juga akan mengecek kesiapan infrastruktur dan lokasi wisata. Langkah ini dilakukan guna mengantisipasi lonjakan pengunjung di destinasi wisata populer yang belum didukung kondisi jalan memadai.

title: Keandalan yang Dirawat di Balik Setiap Perjalanan
summary: Pengalaman terbang dinilai dari ketepatan waktu, kenyamanan kabin, dan keramahan awak kabin.
content:
Bloomberg Technoz, Jakarta - Bagi penumpang, pengalaman terbang sering kali dinilai dari hal-hal yang langsung terlihat: keberangkatan yang tepat waktu, kabin yang nyaman, dan senyum ramah awak kabin. Sementara itu, di dalam hanggar, berlangsung pekerjaan sunyi yang justru turut menentukan kelancaran penerbangan. Di sanalah keandalan armada dirawat dengan presisi tinggi melalui pekerjaan Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO).

Proses pemeliharaan, perbaikan, dan perawatan pesawat secara menyeluruh ini membutuhkan perencanaan jangka panjang, tenaga ahli, serta ketersediaan fasilitas dan suku cadang. Kesiapan inilah yang menjadi salah satu tulang punggung Pelita Air dalam menjaga ketepatan waktu (On-Time Performance/OTP).

Komitmen kepada pelanggan tersebut diwujudkan Pelita Air dengan memperkuat ekosistem perawatan armada Airbus A320 bersama dua mitra global, MTU Maintenance dan KarbonMRO. Melalui kesepakatan yang diresmikan dalam ajang MRO Asia-Pacific 2026 baru-baru ini di Singapura, Pelita Air memadukan kebutuhan pemeliharaan mesin dengan pengembangan kapabilitas teknis masa depan.

“Setiap pihak memiliki kompetensi yang dapat saling melengkapi,” ujar Direktur Utama PT Pelita Air Service, Faik Fahmi. “Dengan memperluas akses terhadap keahlian, fasilitas, dan dukungan teknis yang mumpuni, kami ingin memastikan armada pesawat Pelita Air selalu dalam kondisi prima demi keselamatan dan kenyamanan pelanggan.”

Kerja sama dengan MTU Maintenance disepakati untuk jangka waktu tiga tahun ke depan. Fokusnya adalah merawat mesin CFM56-5B yang menggerakkan 16 pesawat Airbus A320 Pelita Air.

title: Tekan Biaya, Trump Bakal Longgarkan Batasan Metana Sumur Migas
summary: Trump akan mengumumkan rencana pelonggaran ketentuan federal yang dirancang guna memangkas emisi metana dari kegiatan operasional minyak dan gas.
content:
GAS RUMAH KACA Tekan Biaya, Trump Bakal Longgarkan Batasan Metana Sumur Migas

Gas metana yang dibakar terjadi tepat di dekat Carlsbad, New Mexico. (Steven St John/Bloomberg)

Bloomberg, Presiden Donald Trump akan mengumumkan rencana untuk melonggarkan ketentuan federal yang dirancang guna memangkas emisi metana dari kegiatan operasional minyak dan gas. Usulan ini diposisikan sebagai cara untuk mendorong peningkatan produksi energi dalam negeri sekaligus menekan biaya.

Menurut pejabat pemerintah yang meminta tidak disebutkan namanya sebelum pengumuman resmi, Trump diperkirakan akan mengumumkan usulan aturan tersebut dalam kampanye di Lubbock, Texas pada Selasa (27/10/2026).

Langkah ini diambil di tengah upayanya untuk memperkuat posisi kandidat Senat dari Partai Republik, Ken Paxton, menjelang pemilihan sela pekan depan.

Texas merupakan negara bagian penghasil minyak terbesar di AS, dan industri minyak telah melobi Gedung Putih untuk melonggarkan sejumlah mandat yang bertujuan membatasi pelepasan metana—gas rumah kaca yang memiliki dampak pemanasan sangat kuat.

title: Fitch Ratings Proyeksi Ekonomi RI 2027 Hanya Tumbuh 4,9%
summary: Fitch Proyeksi Ekonomi RI Hanya Tumbuh di Bawah 5% Pada 2027
content:
Bloomberg Technoz, Jakarta - Lembaga pemeringkat internasional Fitch Ratings memperkirakan kinerja ekonomi Indonesia dalam jangka menengah, yakni pada 2027 dan 2028 masing-masing hanya akan tumbuh di kisaran 4,9%.

Kendati proyeksi ini direvisi membaik dari estimasi Fitch pada riset periode sebelumnya, yakni 4,7%, namun proyeksi tren pertumbuhan ekonomi tersebut masih jauh di bawah target jangka menengah pemerintah yang diharapkan mencapai 8%.

Hal ini terungkap dalam laporan hasil riset Fitch Ratings bertajuk 'Ketidakpastian Kebijakan dan Hambatan Eksternal Membayangi Prospek Pertumbuhan Indonesia' yang dirilis pada 21 Oktober 2026.

"Kesenjangan tersebut mencerminkan asumsi dasar bahwa reformasi struktural hanya akan memberikan dampak moderat terhadap total factor productivity (produktivitas faktor total) dan capital deepening (pendalaman modal) dalam konteks PDB (produk domestik bruto) potensial Indonesia," papar Analis Fitch Ratings Alex Muscatelli dalam laporannya, dikutip Selasa (27/10/2026).

Menurut dia, Asumsi dasar Fitch adalah bahwa pemerintah Indonesia akan menghadapi tantangan besar untuk mencapai target pertumbuhan jangka menengah yang ambisius, sembari tetap menjaga stabilitas makroekonomi dan keuangan.

title: IHSG Turun 1,99%, Saham BREN, BRPT dan TPIA Jadi Laggard Terberat
summary: IHSG ditutup melemah 1,99% di posisi 5.266 pada Selasa (27/10). Indeks Komposit ditekan performa negatif saham BREN hingga saham TPIA menjadi pemberat
content:
IHSG Turun 1,99%, Saham BREN, BRPT dan TPIA Jadi Laggard Terberat

Karyawan di depan layar pergerakan harga saham (IHSG) di Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI), Jumat (14/8/2026). (Bloomberg Technoz/Andrean Kristianto)

Bloomberg Technoz, Jakarta - Indeks Harga Saham Gabungan (IHSG) ditutup melemah 1,99% di posisi 5.266 pada penutupan perdagangan Selasa (27/10/2026). Indeks Komposit ditekan performa negatif saham PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk (BREN) hingga saham PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (TPIA) menjadi pemberat (laggard).

Sepanjang perdagangan IHSG terus–menerus terpeleset di zona merah. Adapun rentang perdagangan terjadi pada 5.418 hingga terdalam menyentuh 5.182.

Data Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) menunjukkan nilai perdagangan mencapai Rp17,94 triliun dari 36,43 miliar saham ditransaksikan, dengan frekuensi terjadi 1,91 juta kali diperjualbelikan. Tercatat masih ada penguatan 100 saham, dan 611 saham melemah. Sisanya 82 saham stagnan.

Saham–saham energi, saham barang baku, dan saham teknologi menjadi pemberat IHSG dengan tertekan mencapai 3,32%, 3,32%, dan 3,16% begitu juga saham infrastruktur drop 2,95%, disusul oleh pelemahan pada saham transportasi dengan melemah 2,83%.

Terungkap, berdasarkan data Bloomberg, melemahnya IHSG merupakan efek langsung dari tertekannya sejumlah saham big caps yang memiliki bobot besar terhadap Indeks terutama saham BREN hingga saham TPIA.
